cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's Audit Machine test the loan covenants of HANGS Construction Services.
Covenants are promises made to the bank.
These are agreed-upon procedures: specific checks the bank asked for. First it agrees every figure to the books.
The loans agree, but June's interest was never booked.
Tangible net worth is the owners' stake, less what a sister company owes.
Working capital passes too, whichever way the office lease is counted.
Equipment spending comes in just $67,500 under its limit.
Both reports reached the bank on time.
Now it lists what the procedures found.
Then it writes draft findings for the CPA, who issues the report.

All done. All three covenants and the spending limit are met, and the reports were on time. One exception: $28,665 of interest not in the books. Five items stay open, including how the bank reads the lease. The CPA, a person, issues and signs the report. The machine gives no opinion.
